title: NEPENTHE | Auto-SOF: Automated Surrogate-based Optimization Framework
description: Auto-SOF automates the surrogate-based optimization loop used in simulation-driven design: cross-validated surrogate models (21-model registry, hybrid stacked ensembles), ten optimizers including from-scratch NSGA-II/III and HypE, and Pareto-front decision packages in a no-code six-step Streamlit workflow.
